mapper.select: SELECT bulletin_board_id , system_code , bulletin_board_title , bulletin_board_type_code , bb_short_reply_enabled_flag , bb_reply_enabled_flag , bb_attach_file_enable_flag , bb_use_flag FROM LGCOM_BOARD_MASTER_M WHERE bulletin_board_id = #{bulletinBoardId}

SELECT a.bulletin_board_id , a.bulletin_board_no , a.system_code , a.bulletin_board_title , a.bb_body_content , TO_CHAR(a.period_from_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS period_from_date , TO_CHAR(a.period_to_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS period_to_date , a.bb_top_post_flag , a.notice_type_code , a.pop_up_alarm_flag , a.bulletin_board_inquiry_count AS hit_count , TO_CHAR(a.creation_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS wrie_date , a.created_by AS writer_id , NVL(b.full_name_local,b.english_full_name) AS writer_name , f1.file_seq_no AS attach_file1_id , f1.attach_file_name AS attach_file1_name , f1.file_size AS attach_file1_size , f1.system_attach_file_name AS attach_system_file1_name , f2.file_seq_no AS attach_file2_id , f2.attach_file_name AS attach_file2_name , f2.file_size AS attach_file2_size , f2.system_attach_file_name AS attach_system_file2_name , f3.file_seq_no AS attach_file3_id , f3.attach_file_name AS attach_file3_name , f3.file_size AS attach_file3_size , f3.system_attach_file_name AS attach_system_file3_name , a.bulletin_board_parent_id , a.bulletin_board_level_seqs , a.bb_reply_level_depth FROM LGCOM_BOARD_N a , LGCOM_USER_M_V b , LGCOM_BOARD_ATTACH_FILE_N f1 , LGCOM_BOARD_ATTACH_FILE_N f2 , LGCOM_BOARD_ATTACH_FILE_N f3 WHERE a.bulletin_board_id = #{bulletinBoardId} AND a.bulletin_board_no = #{bulletinBoardNo} AND a.delete_flag = 'N' AND a.created_by = b.application_user_id(+) AND a.attach_file1_id = f1.file_seq_no(+) AND a.bulletin_board_no = f1.bulletin_board_no(+) AND f1.use_flag(+) = 'Y' AND a.attach_file2_id = f2.file_seq_no(+) AND a.bulletin_board_no = f2.bulletin_board_no(+) AND f2.use_flag(+) = 'Y' AND a.attach_file3_id = f3.file_seq_no(+) AND a.bulletin_board_no = f3.bulletin_board_no(+) AND f3.use_flag(+) = 'Y'

SELECT bulletin_board_short_reply_no , bulletin_board_no , registrant_name , REPLACE(REPLACE(bb_short_reply_content,chr(13),'
'),chr(10),'
') AS bb_short_reply_content , TO_CHAR(creation_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS creation_date , CASE WHEN created_by = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS own_comment FROM LGCOM_BOARD_SHORT_REPLY_N WHERE bulletin_board_no = #{bulletinBoardNo} ORDER BY bulletin_board_no, bulletin_board_short_reply_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE LGCOM_BOARD_N SET delete_flag = 'Y' , last_updated_by = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} , last_update_date = SYSDATE WHERE bulletin_board_no IN ( SELECT bulletin_board_no FROM LGCOM_BOARD_N START WITH bulletin_board_no = #{bulletinBoardNo} CONNECT BY PRIOR bulletin_board_no = bulletin_board_parent_id)

MERGE INTO LGCOM_BOARD_SHORT_REPLY_N a USING ( SELECT #{bulletinBoardShortReplyNo} AS bulletin_board_short_reply_no , #{bulletinBoardNo} AS bulletin_board_no , #{USER_SESSION.fullNameLocal} registrant_name , #{bbShortReplyContent} AS bb_short_reply_content FROM DUAL ) b ON (a.bulletin_board_short_reply_no = b.bulletin_board_short_reply_no) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (bulletin_board_short_reply_no,bulletin_board_no,registrant_name,bb_short_reply_content, created_by,creation_date,last_updated_by,last_update_date) VALUES (LGCOM_BOARD_SHORT_REPLY_N_SEQ.NEXTVAL,b.bulletin_board_no,b.registrant_name,b.bb_short_reply_content, #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId},SYSDATE,#{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId},SYSDATE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET bb_short_reply_content = #{bbShortReplyContent} , last_updated_by = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} , last_update_date = SYSDATE
mapper.select: SELECT file_seq_no , bulletin_board_no , attach_file_name , system_attach_file_name , file_size , file_desc FROM LGCOM_BOARD_ATTACH_FILE_N WHERE bulletin_board_no = #{bulletinBoardNo} AND use_flag = 'Y' ORDER BY file_seq_no
SELECT file_seq_no , bulletin_board_no , attach_file_name , system_attach_file_name , file_size , file_desc FROM LGCOM_BOARD_ATTACH_FILE_N WHERE file_seq_no = #{fileSeqNo} AND use_flag = 'Y'
SELECT LGCOM_BOARD_N_SEQ.NEXTVAL AS next_bulletin_board_no FROM DUAL
SELECT LGCOM_BOARD_ATTACH_FILE_N_SEQ.NEXTVAL AS next_file_seq_no FROM DUAL
mapper.update: MERGE INTO LGCOM_BOARD_ATTACH_FILE_N a USING ( SELECT #{fileSeqNo} AS file_seq_no , #{bulletinBoardNo} AS bulletin_board_no , #{attachFileName} AS attach_file_name , #{systemAttachFileName} AS system_attach_file_name , #{fileSize} AS file_size , #{creationUserId} AS user_id FROM DUAL ) b ON (a.file_seq_no = b.file_seq_no) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (file_seq_no,bulletin_board_no,attach_file_name,system_attach_file_name,file_size, file_desc,use_flag,created_by,creation_date,last_updated_by,last_update_date) VALUES (b.file_seq_no,b.bulletin_board_no,b.attach_file_name,b.system_attach_file_name,b.file_size, NULL,'Y',b.user_id,SYSDATE,b.user_id,SYSDATE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET attach_file_name = b.attach_file_name , system_attach_file_name = b.system_attach_file_name , file_size = b.file_size , last_updated_by = b.user_id , last_update_date = SYSDATE

UPDATE LGCOM_BOARD_N SET attach_file1_id = NULL , attach_file2_id = NULL , attach_file3_id = NULL , last_updated_by = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} , last_update_date = SYSDATE WHERE bulletin_board_no = #{bulletinBoardNo}

UPDATE LGCOM_BOARD_N SET attach_file1_id = DECODE(attach_file1_id,#{fileSeqNo},NULL,attach_file1_id) , attach_file2_id = DECODE(attach_file2_id,#{fileSeqNo},NULL,attach_file2_id) , attach_file3_id = DECODE(attach_file3_id,#{fileSeqNo},NULL,attach_file3_id) , last_updated_by = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} , last_update_date = SYSDATE WHERE bulletin_board_no = #{bulletinBoardNo}

UPDATE LGCOM_BOARD_N SET attach_file1_id = DECODE(#{attachFile1Id},-1,NULL,#{attachFile1Id}) , attach_file2_id = DECODE(#{attachFile2Id},-1,NULL,#{attachFile2Id}) , attach_file3_id = DECODE(#{attachFile3Id},-1,NULL,#{attachFile3Id}) , last_updated_by = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} , last_update_date = SYSDATE WHERE bulletin_board_no = #{bulletinBoardNo}
